source: Dunlop Motorcycle Tires, Geomax off-road tire pressure guidance (MX hardpack and intermediate 12 front / 12.5 rear, four-stroke front 13 to 14; soft 12 / 12; sand 11 to 12; mud 12 / 10; off-road 13 / 14; desert and rocks 14 to 16), read 2026-09-07

hardpack.reason: Dunlop starting point for hardpack and intermediate MX: 12 front, 12.5 rear. Four-strokes often run 13 to 14 up front.

loam.reason: Dunlop starting point for soft MX terrain: 12 front, 12 rear. A touch of give for bite in the top layer.

sand.reason: Dunlop's sand range is 11 to 12. Starting at 12 front, 11.5 rear so the tire floats and hooks up.

mud.reason: Dunlop starting point for mud: 12 front, 10 rear. The low rear opens the knobs for grip.

hardpack.reason: Dunlop starting point for off-road: 13 front, 14 rear. Rocks and desert run 14 to 16 to protect the tube.

loam.reason: Dunlop starting point for off-road: 13 front, 14 rear. Drop a psi where the ground is soft and the rocks are gone.

sand.reason: Dunlop's sand range is 11 to 12. Starting at 12 front, 12 rear with a tube in mind.

mud.reason: Dunlop starting point for mud: 12 front, 10 rear. The low rear opens the knobs for grip.

tubliss.reason: Low pressure grips at crawl speed and gets vague at high speed.

mousse.reason: No pressure to set on a mousse. It rides like roughly 12 to 16 psi.
